EP32:E4 3800-5200 CATHERINE [Mocking, Savoring]: "There it is."
EP32:E5 4500-7500 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of Catherine in her opulent velvet gown, clutching the hot poker with a sadistic sneer.
EP32:E6 7500-9200 CATHERINE [Whispering, Venomous]: "Fear."
EP32:E7 7500-10500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward over the burning book, eyes glittering with malice.
EP32:E8 9800-13200 CATHERINE [Taunting]: "You have been so proud of that brave little face..."
EP32:E9 10500-13500 CAMERA: Wide shot showing Juliana chained against the cold dungeon wall, small and restrained beneath Catherine's towering shadow.
EP32:E10 13400-15800 CATHERINE [Smug, Dominant]: "...but now you are afraid."
EP32:E11 13500-16000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine straightening up haughtily.
EP32:E12 16000-17000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana, her lips trembling in agonizing sorrow.
EP32:E13 16200-18800 CATHERINE [Cruel, Final]: "Say goodbye to your mother."
EP32:E14 17000-19000 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Catherine swinging the flaming orange iron upward from the book.
EP32:E15 18800-20500 ACTION: Juliana's despair suddenly solidifies. Her jaw tightens, tears stopping as resolve takes over.
EP32:E16 19000-20500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up directly at Catherine, fear replaced by cold conviction.
EP32:E17 20200-22000 JULIANA [Defiant, Unbroken]: "Burn it."
EP32:E18 20500-23000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana, sitting upright despite her heavy iron shackles.
EP32:E19 23000-25500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine, her smug expression abruptly flickering with startled confusion.
EP32:E20 23800-24800 CATHERINE [Disconcerted]: "What?"
EP32:E21 25500-28500 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Juliana staring straight up into Catherine's eyes without flinching.
EP32:E22 25800-28800 JULIANA [Firm, Resolute]: "Burn the ledger. Burn every page."
EP32:E23 28500-30800 CAMERA: Wide shot of the wet dungeon floor, guards stationed by the heavy iron doorway in the background as Catherine holds the hot brand.
EP32:E24 29800-32800 JULIANA [Steely, Proud]: "You may destroy the book..."
EP32:E25 30800-33500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face darkening with irritation.
EP32:E26 33500-36500 CAMERA: Medium low-angle shot of Juliana sitting amidst chains beneath the barred ceiling grate.
EP32:E27 33200-36200 JULIANA [Transcendent, Defiant]: "...you cannot destroy what my mother taught me."
EP32:E28 36400-38800 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine leaning down aggressively into Juliana's space, trembling with offended rage.
EP32:E29 36400-39100 CATHERINE [Spiteful, Hissing]: "You think a few herbs make you better than me?"
EP32:E30 38800-41000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking steadily up into Catherine's furious glare.
EP32:E31 39200-42800 JULIANA [Calm, Cutting]: "No. Your cruelty does that for me."
EP32:E32 41000-43500 CAMERA: High-angle over-the-shoulder shot looking down at Juliana bound in heavy chains on the damp floor.
EP32:E33 43500-45500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Catherine, baring her teeth in outrage.
EP32:E34 43400-45400 CATHERINE [Furious, Shouting]: "You still think you are better?!"
EP32:E35 45500-47800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana, her chained hands clasped together in her lap.
EP32:E36 45600-47400 JULIANA [Serene, Grounded]: "I know what I am."
EP32:E37 47800-49000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine scoffing with forced, derisive laughter.
EP32:E38 47800-49000 CATHERINE [Sneering, Mocking]: "A disgraced woman?"
EP32:E39 49000-52500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana speaking with undeniable strength.
EP32:E40 49200-52400 JULIANA [Unwavering]: "A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me."
EP32:E41 52500-54400 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine brandishing the glowing tong in Juliana's face, spittle flying from her lips.
EP32:E42 52800-54200 CATHERINE [Screaming, Enraged]: "You are lying!"
EP32:E43 54400-58000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking straight up, voice steady and clear.
EP32:E44 54600-58000 JULIANA [Measured, Emphatic]: "Gerald leaving me was the best thing he ever did for me."
EP32:E45 58000-60800 CAMERA: Full shot of the dungeon cell. Catherine stands rigidly tall while Juliana sits shackled on the ground.
EP32:E46 58200-61000 JULIANA [Contemplative, Scathing]: "He wanted a woman who looked beautiful beside his wealth."
EP32:E47 60800-64500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's expressive blue eyes and tear-stained cheek.
EP32:E48 61100-66800 JULIANA [Passionate, Clear]: "He wanted a wife whose family could raise his name. He measured a woman's worth by what she could give him."
EP32:E49 64500-67000 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Juliana leaning slightly forward against her chains.
EP32:E50 67000-69000 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine staring down, her eyes widening as Juliana's words pierce her facade.
EP32:E51 67200-68900 JULIANA [Unapologetic, Victorious]: "Let him have Clarissa."
EP32:E52 69000-71200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana smiling with genuine liberation.
EP32:E53 69600-71200 JULIANA [Proud]: "He lost me."
EP32:E54 71200-73300 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Catherine's face contorting in sheer fury.
EP32:E55 71300-73200 CATHERINE [Shrieking, Vicious]: "You were rejected!"
EP32:E56 73300-75500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's calm, resolute face.
EP32:E57 73400-77600 JULIANA [Grounded, Powerful]: "I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth."
EP32:E58 75500-77500 CAMERA: Wide shot of the cell, steam rising faintly in the cold subterranean air.
EP32:E59 77500-80000 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine sneering with dripping condescension.
EP32:E60 77800-79400 CATHERINE [Disdainful]: "Your soldier?"
EP32:E61 80000-82500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glowing with genuine devotion.
EP32:E62 80200-82000 JULIANA [Tender, Certain]: "My husband."
EP32:E63 82500-84100 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine scowling with deep disgust.
EP32:E64 82500-84000 CATHERINE [Bitter]: "He is a nobody."
EP32:E65 84100-86500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, totally untroubled.
EP32:E66 84200-86200 JULIANA [Warm, Defiant]: "Then I love a nobody."
EP32:E67 86500-89800 CAMERA: Low-angle shot focusing on Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron on the stone floor.
EP32:E68 86500-90200 JULIANA [Resonant, Moving]: "Because that nobody showed me more love than your entire world ever did."
EP32:E69 89800-92800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine gripping the branding rod tighter, her upper lip curling in fury.
EP32:E70 90100-92600 CATHERINE [Indignant, Sharp]: "You know nothing about my world."
EP32:E71 92800-97000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana sitting in her tattered apron and chains, looking composed.
EP32:E72 93200-96600 JULIANA [Knowing, Sober]: "I know exactly what your world values."
EP32:E73 97000-99800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's lips and eyes as she lists them with chilling precision.
EP32:E74 97600-99600 JULIANA [Listing, Deliberate]: "Beauty. Money."
EP32:E75 99800-101000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Catherine's wide, stunned eyes reacting to the naked truth.
EP32:E76 101000-103700 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up unflinchingly.
EP32:E77 101200-103500 JULIANA [Firm]: "Family. A perfect name."
EP32:E78 103700-107000 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her gold and purple gown, the guard standing sentinel behind her.
EP32:E79 103800-107200 JULIANA [Continuing]: "And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her."
EP32:E80 107000-108800 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine throwing her hands up in explosive defensiveness.
EP32:E81 107200-108800 CATHERINE [Shouting, Outraged]: "And what is wrong with that?!"
EP32:E82 108800-109400 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face twisting in absolute venom.
EP32:E83 109400-112500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking serene.
EP32:E84 109500-112800 JULIANA [Gentle, Penetrating]: "Nothing. Until you have nothing left beneath it."
EP32:E85 112500-116000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine standing motionless, holding the iron rod, struck to the core by the insult.
EP32:E86 112800-116000 JULIANA [Unrelenting]: "You have spent your whole life collecting things that make people bow..."
EP32:E87 116000-116800 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Juliana's chained hands folded peacefully in her lap.
EP32:E88 116800-119500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up with quiet pity.
EP32:E89 116900-119500 JULIANA [Piercing]: "...but you have never learned how to make anyone love you."
EP32:E90 119500-121800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine snapping entirely, raising the branding poker like a weapon and screaming.
EP32:E91 119600-121800 CATHERINE [Hysterical, Screaming]: "Silence! Silence!"
EP32:E92 121800-123000 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's crazed, gasping face.
EP32:E93 121800-122800 CATHERINE [Shrieking]: "Why?!"
EP32:E94 122800-125000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana crying out her defiance.
EP32:E95 123000-125200 JULIANA [Forceful]: "Because I am right!"
EP32:E96 125000-128500 CAMERA: Low-angle tracking shot of the red-hot branding tip trailing across the wet dungeon floor, steaming.
EP32:E97 125400-128800 JULIANA [Scathing, Direct]: "You want everyone to believe you are powerful."
EP32:E98 128500-131800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana sitting under the cold skylight bars, her posture majestic despite her imprisonment.
EP32:E99 129000-131600 JULIANA [Continuing]: "You want everyone to fear you."
EP32:E100 131800-134800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana looking directly at Catherine, gestures restrained by the heavy iron chains.
EP32:E101 132000-134000 JULIANA [Mocking, Direct]: "But look at you."
EP32:E102 134800-138500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes burning with fiery contempt.
EP32:E103 135000-138600 JULIANA [Stripping Her Bare]: "You have to threaten a chained woman to feel powerful!"
EP32:E104 138500-140400 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine trembling with uncontrollable rage, teeth bared.
EP32:E105 138600-140200 CATHERINE [Choking with Rage]: "You insolent—!"
EP32:E106 140400-142400 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine gripping the glowing tongs as Juliana continues speaking over her.
EP32:E107 140400-142300 JULIANA [Steely, Triumphant]: "You may have the title you have always wanted..."
EP32:E108 142400-146500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana delivering the final emotional blow.
EP32:E109 142400-146500 JULIANA [Final, Condemning]: "...but you will never have the courage to earn what you demand from everyone else."
EP32:E110 146500-148000 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face twitching with sheer murderous madness.
EP32:E111 146600-148100 CATHERINE [Enraged, Shouting]: "You think you can lecture me?!"
EP32:E112 148000-150800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine raising the branding iron high above her head with both hands.
EP32:E113 148000-150800 ACTION: Catherine hoists the searing branding rod over Juliana with frantic fury.
EP32:E114 148100-151200 CATHERINE [Screaming, Maniacal]: "Then let's see how brave you are when it touches your skin!"
EP32:E115 150800-152000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine plunging the glowing orange poker straight toward Juliana's face.
EP32:E116 151200-154380 ACTION: Juliana gasps, freezing as the glowing tip of the iron thrusts forward, stopping mere millimeters from her right eye.
EP32:E117 152000-154380 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, unblinking blue eye. The intense, fiery orange glow of the iron poker radiates inches from her cornea, holding on the heart-stopping cliffhanger as the frame cuts to black.
